incident-bot: [AUTOPAGER] PagerDuty -> #eng-oncall: HOST_HEARTBEAT_LOST host=gpu-node-78 rack=rt12 region=eu-west-1 severity=critical :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Pager details: PD-INC-8821, triggered by node-heartbeat monitor (timeout 30s). Autoresponder attempted serial attach.

maria_oncall: acked. I'm on it. attaching serial console now.

maria_oncall: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-node-78` shows: 
```
gpu-node-78   NotReady  4d    3h   192.168.72.78   <none>   agent/rt12
```

maria_oncall: kubelet logs show repeated kernel oops and then panic. grabbing dmesg.

maria_oncall: dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, GPU crashed on channel 0
[ 1234.568001] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: nvme: fatal error
[ 1234.568110] call trace: 
  ? dump_stack+0x45/0x5b
  ? __warn+0xcb/0x110
```

kevin_sre: oncall handoff in 10m? If this is nvme/kernel panic we should cordon and drain remaining pods on that host if possible.

maria_oncall: attempt serial attach succeeded briefly, saw kernel panic logs. node won't come back. Initiating cordon + drain -> `kubectl cordon gpu-node-78 && kubectl drain gpu-node-78 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

ops-bot: `kubectl drain` progress: 12/24 pods evicted, 8 pending (statefulsets), 4 stuck on local volumes.

jana_support: customer-impact check: metrics show increased 5xx and latency from tenants pinned to rt12 / eu-west-1 for generation endpoints. Main affected: dedicated-tenant-42, shared-route-graphql-v2.

liam_platform: routing policy auto-failover triggered for region eu-west-1 -> traffic shifted to eu-central spare pool. However dedicated tenants on reserved capacity in rt12 don't failover automatically; we need manual remediation for those.

maria_oncall: started bursting to host-pool-eu-central for shared workloads. Notifying accounts team.

kevin_sre: I'm taking the page. Assigning self as incident commander. I'll coordinate RMA and kernel logs. Maria, leave node cordoned. We'll not reboot until RMA/firmware check.

kevin_sre: quick checklist: 1) preserve logs (serial + dmesg) 2) check nvme SMART 3) collect pod lists and tenant mappings 4) notify dedicated capacity owners (sales/SE)

maria_oncall: logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/1792223333/gpu-node-78/ and snapshot uploaded.

jana_support: notified customer success + sent initial heads-up to affected tenants: "We observed degraded performance in eu-west-1. We're failing over shared traffic and working on restoring dedicated hosts. We'll share ETA in 30m."

kevin_sre: NVMe SMART shows media errors. Likely hardware fault. Requesting rack ops to open RMA and schedule replacement.

liam_platform: for dedicated-tenant-42, we can offer temporary burst capacity in other racks; starting manual migration plan. Will coordinate with SE.

maria_oncall: temporary mitigation: scaled up fallback CPU variants for some heavy pipelines to keep tail latency sane. Changed model routing policy for route-id `gen-eu-west-1` -> added fallback: `prefer: spare-gpu | fallback: cpu-quantized` (rolled in 2m).

kevin_sre: impact summary so far (preliminary): - host gpu-node-78 hard-failed (kernel panic) - ~3 dedicated units in rt12 impacted (manual remediation needed) - shared endpoints experienced latency spikes for 7 minutes before failover stabilized - no customer data lost, no unauthorized access.

incident-bot: PagerDuty status updated: PD-INC-8821 acknowledged by kevin_sre. Autopager runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.dev/host/kernel-panic

maria_oncall: reactions: :white_check_mark: on archive, :eyes: on migration.

kevin_sre: I'm creating an incident page and assigning postmortem owner. Postmortem owner: kevin_sre. Follow ups: NVMe firmware check across fleet, validate monitoring thresholds (heartbeat timeout too low for transient serial attach?), add eviction policy for dedicated tenants to avoid single-host capacity loss.

jana_support: scheduled customer followup at T+1h with impacted accounts.

liam_platform: rebalancer will try to fill empty slots in rt12 with warm nodes; but RMA required for gpu-node-78 to restore capacity.

maria_oncall: handing off operational command to kevin_sre. I'm available for execution steps.

kevin_sre: taking ownership. next updates in 10m or on major change. tagging: @ops, @sales-rt12.

ops-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-4498 for gpu-node-78, priority P1.

kevin_sre: closing thread for active chat control; will update incident channel with timeline and RCA once we have kernel/firmware analysis.

maria_oncall: :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: [AUTOPAGER] PD-INC-8821 -> status: active -> acknowledged by kevin_sre.
